mapper.sql: SELECT tenant_id::text, agent_id::text, status, pinned_version, config, created_at, updated_at FROM tenant_agent_binding
mapper.select: INSERT INTO tenant_agent_binding (tenant_id, agent_id, status, pinned_version, config, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{tenantId}::uuid, #{agentId}::uuid, 'ACTIVE', #{pinnedVersion}, #{config}::jsonb, now(), now()) ON CONFLICT (tenant_id, agent_id) DO UPDATE SET status = 'ACTIVE', pinned_version = EXCLUDED.pinned_version, config = EXCLUDED.config, updated_at = now() RETURNING tenant_id, agent_id, status, pinned_version, config, created_at, updated_at
mapper.update: UPDATE tenant_agent_binding SET pinned_version = #{pinnedVersion}, config = #{config}::jsonb, updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND status = 'ACTIVE'
UPDATE tenant_agent_binding SET status = 'SUSPENDED', updated_at = now() WHERE tenant_id = #{tenantId}::uuid AND agent_id = #{agentId}::uuid AND status = 'ACTIVE'
